readmeExcerpt:
# uBlock filter list to hide all YouTube Shorts

A maintained [uBlock Origin](https://github.com/gorhill/uBlock) filter list to hide all traces of YouTube shorts videos.

Copy the link below, go to uBlock Origin > Dashboard > Filter lists, scroll to the bottom, and paste the link underneath the 'Import...' heading:  
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/i5heu/ublock-hide-yt-shorts/master/list.txt`

[> uBlock Origin subscribe link <](ubo:subscribe?location=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/i5heu/ublock-hide-yt-shorts/master/list.txt) (does not work on GitHub)

## Bonus: hide YouTube Comments

`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/i5heu/ublock-hide-yt-shorts/master/comments.txt`

[> uBlock Origin subscribe link <](ubo:subscribe?location=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/i5heu/ublock-hide-yt-shorts/master/comments.txt) (does not work on GitHub)

## Bonus: hide YouTube Playables
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/i5heu/ublock-hide-yt-shorts/master/playables.txt`

[> uBlock Origin subscribe link <](ubo:subscribe?location=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/i5heu/ublock-hide-yt-shorts/master/playables.txt) (does not work on GitHub)

## Maintenance

After the initial createor of this list [@gijsdev](https://github.com/gijsdev) is now vanished for half a year, i ( [i5heu](https://heidenstedt.org) ) took it on me to maintain this list.

aiSummary.oneLiner: A maintained uBlock Origin filter list dedicated entirely to hiding all traces of YouTube Shorts.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: ublock-hide-yt-shorts is a highly targeted collection of custom filter rules designed specifically for the uBlock Origin browser extension to eradicate YouTube Shorts from the user interface. It meticulously targets the DOM elements associated with the Shorts shelf on the homepage, the dedicated Shorts tab in the sidebar, and Shorts recommendations within standard search results. By utilizing advanced CSS selectors, the filters dynamically adapt to YouTube's frequent layout changes without breaking the core functionality of the site. The project restores a classic, long-form focused video browsing experience, eliminating the addictive, short-form content feeds entirely. It is lightweight, requires no additional software beyond an adblocker, and is actively maintained by the community.
keyFeatures: Comprehensive Shorts Eradication: Completely removes the Shorts shelf from the homepage, search results, and the main navigation sidebar.
Dynamic DOM Targeting: Utilizes advanced uBlock Origin CSS selectors to accurately hide elements even as YouTube aggressively changes class names.
Zero Performance Overhead: Relies entirely on native adblocker rendering engines, ensuring the browser doesn't slow down while hiding content.
Classic Interface Restoration: Forces the platform to focus exclusively on standard, long-form video content, improving the user's focus and experience.
Cross-Browser Compatibility: Works flawlessly on any browser supporting the uBlock Origin extension, including Firefox, Chrome, and Edge.
Community-Driven Updates: Actively maintained filter lists adapt quickly to bypass YouTube's latest attempts to force Shorts into the user interface.

useCases.title: Improving Digital Wellbeing
useCases.description: Users can break the habit of doom-scrolling by completely removing the highly addictive short-form video interface from their daily browsing.

useCases.title: Restoring the Classic YouTube Experience
useCases.description: Long-time viewers can force the platform to display only the traditional, long-form content format they originally signed up for.

useCases.title: Cleaning Up Search Results
useCases.description: Researchers and students can prevent irrelevant Shorts from cluttering up educational or tutorial video search queries.

useCases.title: Optimizing Browser Performance
useCases.description: Users on low-end devices can prevent the heavy, auto-playing Shorts carousel from loading and consuming valuable system resources.

useCases.title: Parental Content Control
useCases.description: Parents can apply these filters to their children's browsers to restrict access to the fast-paced, often unmoderated Shorts feed.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This filter list is for desktop YouTube users utilizing uBlock Origin who prefer traditional video formats over short-form content. It requires basic familiarity with adding custom filters to adblockers.
aiSummary.gettingStarted: Copy the raw list URL and paste it into uBlock Origin's custom filter lists settings.
